entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit! This is never gonna end!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems hopeless if there are this many[n]inmates supporting it...

entries.speaker: Godlike Voice
entries.en: You fools. Human, yet wishing to[n]eradicate the desires of humanity...

entries.speaker: Godlike Voice
entries.en: I am revered as the granter of dreams[n]for all who behold me...

entries.speaker: Godlike Voice
entries.en: A being most commonly known as[n]the Holy Grail...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: The Prison of Regression is representative[n]of the collective desires of humanity.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: They wish to be chained down, surrender[n]their cognition, and neglect the world[n]around them...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: These feebleminded commonfolk will[n]make your "social reform" all for naught.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: The shared heart of the masses has[n]fallen into an excess of indolence[n]and transformed into a prison.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Thus... the only suitable end for them is[n]to perish within the prison they wished[n]for themselves.
